1981-2415-5708-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-5708-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

225-5531-5694-6991-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-5531-5694-6991-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Donnie & April and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Donnie & April and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-5531-5694-6991-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Donnie & April and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

6575-7936.description:
Cast Dominion Saboteur by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Esper Terra that isn't legendary. This will cause it to enter the battlefield with a lore counter as it will be a Saga.
Dominion Saboteur's first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Dominion Saboteur with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste that isn't legendary and with one to four lore counters on it.
The Dominion Saboteur token's chapter abilities will trigger according to how many lore counters were placed on it.
Resolve the first Dominion Saboteur trigger, creating a token copy of Dominion Saboteur with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste that isn't legendary and with one to four lore counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1724-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5567-5686-7824--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-5686-7824--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-3259-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1545-1895-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1545-1895-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6136.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6136.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

339-677-3967-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3277-3617-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

855-2265-3099-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Hardened Scales and Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

628-997-7219.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

546-4585-4613-5900.easyPrerequisites: There are at least five total creatures on the battlefield.
546-4585-4613-5900.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Custodi Soulbinders. Custodi Soulbinders enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Custodi Soulbinders using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3814-5776-6871.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and Ygra, and another land you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7157.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1115-2105-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
1115-2105-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1621-4590-6867.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that can attack this turn.
1621-4590-6867.description:
Declare two creatures as attackers, ensuring to attack two different opponents. Commander Liara Portyr triggers, causing spells you cast from exile this turn to cost {2} less to cast.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa
Repeat from step 3.

339-413-677-1879.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

182-6323.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Jumbo Cactuar, causing each opponent to lose 10,000 life.

1432-4513-6566.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
1432-4513-6566.description:
Activate Yuna by tapping it, adding {1} and causing the next creature spell you cast to enter with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Saryth by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Saryth and Yuna.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast a creature spell, causing it to enter the battlefield with infinite +1/+1 counters due to Yuna.

1432-1604.notablePrerequisites:
Ith and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional legendary creature.
1432-1604.description:
Declare Ioreth as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Ith by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ith and any other legendary creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1971-4013-4929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater, or have one exiled by Yannik.
1971-4013-4929.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Yannik.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, all creatures exiled with it return to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling another creature you control with power two or greater and putting at least two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2034-2302-3108-3374-4727.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, targeting another creature.
Repeat until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Grim Poppet persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Grim Poppet, adding {C}{C}.
Grim Poppet dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a total of four -1/-1 counters on it.
Repeat.

162-1636-4265.notablePrerequisites: Royal Assassin does not have summoning sickness.
162-1636-4265.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control, it enters tapped due to Frozen Aether and triggers Intruder Alarm.
Holding priority, activate Royal Assassin by tapping it, destroying the creature.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

3038-3858.notablePrerequisites: Colossification attached to any creature you control.
3038-3858.description: At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, causing you to gain ten life and win the game.

285-1623.notablePrerequisites: You have any spell in hand with the mana to cast it.
285-1623.description:
Cast any spell.
Nether Void triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger, exiling the spell and casting it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
